Batch crawl of 2 seed URLs with links to discover

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_depth' => 1, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
urls = ['https://example.com/seed1', 'https://example.com/seed2']
result = Crawlberg.batch_crawl(engine, urls)
puts result.completed_count.inspect
puts result.failed_count.inspect
puts result.total_count.inspect
```
